subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Reads phonic words in sentences and other texts

show.line: Now we read sentences! The dog sat on the mat. Point to each word and read.

rounds.text: The cat is on the mat.
accept: the cat is on the mat
the cat is on the mat.

rounds.prompt: Which picture matches? The hen is in the pen.
rounds.praise: Yes! The hen is in the pen.

rounds.prompt: Read the sentence strip. Which word is hot?

rounds.story: Dad has a red hat. The hat is on the dog! What is on the dog?
rounds.praise: The hat is on the dog!

hints: Point to each word. Sound it out if you get stuck.
Read it again, faster. Make it sound like talking.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! m, a, t. The cat is on the mat.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. The cat is on the mat!

parent_line: Can read short sentences made of phonic words and sight words.
